entities.name: Samuel B. Moore
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Samuel B. Moore was the sixth governor of Alabama from March 3 to November 26, 1831. He was president of the Alabama Senate when Governor Gabriel Moore was elected to the United States Senate, and so became governor when Gabriel Moore resigned to take the seat.
